footnotes: Figures are from the company's Form 20-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 64.0% to $1.0B in 2025. Gross margin was 60.3%, versus 62.6% a year earlier, and the operating loss narrowed to $136M from $310M.
The net loss widened to $297M, or −$0.81 per share, from $177M. Operating cash flow was −$100M and free cash flow −$129M, versus −$158M.
sources: Legend Biotech Corporation Form 20-F for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
